# `aitbc exchange order cancel`

Sign and submit a cancel for one of this node's own orders.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc exchange order cancel [OPTIONS] ORDER_ID
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `order_id` | integer | yes | — |

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--expires-in` | integer | `120` | no | Blocks until the cancel envelope expires |
| `--wallet` | text | — | no | Wallet name or file path — must be the order owner's |
| `--password-stdin` | flag | `false` | no | Read the wallet password from one line of standard input |
| `--password-file` | file | — | no | Path to a file containing only the wallet password (mode 0600, owned by you) |
| `--password` | text | — | no | Wallet password (deprecated: visible in process lists and shell history; prefer --password-stdin or --password-file) |
| `--chain-id` | text | — | no | Envelope chain_id (default: island credentials) |
| `--exchange-url` | text | — | no | Override exchange service base URL |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc exchange order cancel ORDER_ID
```
